rationale: The first reply correctly explained incomplete combustion and CO risk and gave a reasonable, safe burner-cleaning route, but it asked no questions at all and jumped to DIY before establishing whether there was any gas smell (the key check the ground truth says must be asked); it also hedged with 'If you must, open a window' rather than a firm stop-use. The customer volunteered the smell, and the second reply handled it very well: National Gas Emergency Service 0800 111 999 (plus NI number), ventilate, ECV at meter, no sparks/switches, evacuate if strong, then Gas Safe engineer for leak and burner. No invented facts, no parts, correct escalation; weakness is purely in question ordering/proactive safety screening.
